spec_items.ref: Curtain walling - Kawneer AA100 zone-drained stick system. Both suppliers offer the same system.
Windows - Kawneer AA720 thermally broken casements. Both suppliers offer the same system.
Doors - Kawneer AA190TB thermally broken. Both suppliers offer the same system. Windglass state all doors fabricated to Kawneer PAS24 testing; CAA do not mention PAS24 at all.

SOLAR CONTROL GLASS - Windglass GL101 (positions 01-10) is 8mm toughened Super Neutral 70/35 / 16mm cavity / 10.8mm laminated HEAT SOAKED, and GL100 (positions 11-15) is 6mm toughened SG Superneutral 70/35 / 16mm / 6.8mm laminated clear heat soaked. CAA quote the SAME SCHEME as 28mm: 6mm clear laminated / 16mm black warm edge argon / 6mm clear toughened - NO SOLAR CONTROL COATING NAMED, NO HEAT SOAKING. Roughly 445 m2 of glazing on a school teaching block.

U-VALUE - Windglass state a weighted U-value of 1.4 W/m2K has been achieved, and separately that 'No U values or barrier loads calculated' unless stated. CAA quote 141 states NO U-value anywhere in four pages. The Borras specification requirement is not in our possession - the September 2025 tender documents are not attached to any of the five work orders.

BRISE SOLEIL - excluded in terms by Windglass; not mentioned by CAA. The Borras programme carries two separate install activities, 'Install Brise Soleils to screen CW1' (03/12/2027-09/12/2027) and 'Install Brise Soleils to windows 06, 16 & 26' (10/12/2027-16/12/2027), and lists 'Brise Soleils' as its own trade contractor line separate from 'Windows and Doors - External'.

LOUVRES - Windglass state 'horizontally shaded areas are louvres' and price them within the curtain wall positions. The Borras programme lists a separate 'Louvre Specialist' trade line and describes the window install as 'some with integrated Louvres'.
Glazed spandrel panels - Windglass 'diagonal are glazed spandrel panels', priced within the CW positions. CAA silent.

CAA PC SUMS carried outside the GBP 183,800: Cranage GBP 3,000; kick plates GBP 135 each; automatic door opener GBP 5,000 EACH; fire escape push bar hardware pack GBP 750; teleflex GBP 200 each. None of these are quantified, so none of them are in the headline.
Siderise cladding and removal/disposal - omitted by CAA in terms.

Manifestation - CAA include manifestation on CW screen glass. Windglass exclude manifestations unless stated. The Borras programme has 'Manifestations to glass' as its own trade line, 13/01/2028-12/02/2028.
Trickle vents - Windglass exclude in terms ('No tricklevents... unless stated in quote'). CAA silent.

Glazed balustrades to bridge and canopy - separate 'Glazed Balustrading' trade line on the Borras programme, 11/10/2027-22/10/2027. Neither supplier quote touches it and it is not in the T0689 enquiry title (curtain walling, windows and external doors).

exposures.item: THE TWO QUOTES ARE NOT THE SAME PRODUCT AND THE CHEAPER ONE IS THE ONE WE USED. CAA offer 6mm clear laminated / 16mm argon / 6mm clear toughened with NO solar control coating and NO heat soaking, and state no U-value in four pages. Windglass offer Super Neutral 70/35 solar control with 10.8mm laminated heat-soaked outer and state a weighted 1.4 W/m2K. Approximately 445 m2 of glazing on a sixth form teaching block. This is the Filwood and Brocks Hill pattern one step upstream: the performance was never stated in the document the price came from, so nobody noticed the offer might not carry it.
exposures.our_recourse: The Borras specification is not in our possession, so we cannot yet say which of the two meets it. Request the September 2025 tender documents from Matt with the review.

exposures.item: THE PROGRAMME DOES NOT MEAN WHAT THE COVERING EMAIL IMPLIES. Matt wrote that main works commence in the New Year, and they do - possession 05/01/2027. But this package installs 13/10/2027 to 10/12/2027 (brise soleil to 16/12/2027), in nine sequenced activities: GF curved screens 13/10, GF punched windows 15/10, FF punched windows/screens 26/10, three-storey screen CW11 12/11, SF punched windows/screens 16/11, two-storey screen CW1 24/11, three-storey screen CW03 29/11, windows 06/16/26 02/12, GF doors DX01-DX04 07/12. Materials are bought mid-2027. The gap between the price and the buy is about 26 months, not 15.
exposures.our_recourse: Any adjustment advised to Borras must run to the Q4 2027 install window, and must say so on its face.

exposures.item: THE PHASING IS ITSELF A COST EVENT UNDER THE SUPPLIER'S OWN TERMS. Windglass price 'one site visit' and reserve the right to charge where work 'becomes separately phased'. The programme is nine visits behind a moving scaffold. CAA are silent on visit count, which is not the same as having allowed for nine.
exposures.our_recourse: raise it as a specific, evidenced adjustment head rather than a general inflation uplift.

exposures.item: BORRAS DO NOT HAVE THE JOB YET. The programme's own first two lines are Planning Approval finishing 13/11/2026 and Contractor appointment 16/11/2026. Matt's email says planning is 'likely to be approved in October'. The programme is the document; the email is a week or six out from it. If planning slips again the whole sequence moves and this review is spent.
